clue: Homology model of the Fab from an earlier CVA6 immune complex (5XS7; Discovery Studio), docked into a segmented capsid map; only the V domains were built. The mouse IGKV1-117 light chain has an 11-residue CDR-L1, the template light chain a 6-residue one. The run (IMGT 1-32, +1) covers FR1 and stops in CDR1, where the lengths differ.

Chainsaw model from 7C2L (a different antibody), MDFF into the whole-spike map and the focused RBD-Fab map. The N-terminus is built from IMGT 1 but the strand is one residue off (1-9, -1), with poor site fit (24th percentile). The same slip is in the sibling entries 7czr/7czs/7czv/7d00 of the same paper.

Recorded starting models include 6CMO, a Fab from the Xu H.E. lab at the same institute. Its light chain is 98% identical and carries the same N-terminal slip (-2). This is a near-identical template copy, missed by the identical-sequence copy rule. The same applies to 7jhh and 7m74.

No starting model recorded and no open-access text. SEQRES starts at IMGT 2. The whole FR1 is shifted -1 (2-31). The period control 7whz (another lab) has an identical IGLV1-40 window sequence and was built correctly.
ABodyBuilder model, built in ISOLDE then Phenix in an icosahedral poliovirus map. The construct starts at IMGT 4 (SEQRES truncated), so the strand has no N-terminal anchor (4-16, -1).

Starting model 6T3F (a different Fab, 81% identity, same lengths at the site). Three N-terminal residues are unbuilt, so the built strand starts at IMGT 4 (4-17, -1). The V region is far from germline (67%).

An AlphaFold2 model of the rabbit Fab E82.AS was the starting model, then ISOLDE and Phenix. The rabbit VH sequence starts at IMGT 3 (QSVEESRG), but the strand was built one residue off (3-9, -1; 20th-percentile fit). An AlphaFold start did not prevent an N-terminal slip.
X-ray molecular replacement with 5W53/5EN2. Two N-terminal residues are unbuilt. Run 3-8 (-1) with RSCC at the 14th percentile and a site B-factor z of +1.9.

No starting model recorded; symmetry expansion plus focused classification. The run spans CDR2 to the end of FR3 (62-93, +1) next to 3 unbuilt residues. The light chain of the same paper (7e3c) also slipped.

Unpublished (2026). Kappa CDR2/FR3 run 58-72 (+3) in a chain whose ANARCI gap pattern at IMGT 59-62 disagrees with SAbR in all 3 scanned chains. This is possibly a gap-placement artifact (no high-resolution example).

clue: Templates chosen by BLAST: 1KIQ for VH and 5XJM for VL. They were docked into a locally refined Fv/RBD map and refined in Coot, ISOLDE and Phenix. The CDR2 slip (54-59, +1) sits at the antigen interface. The template has the same CDR2 length, so this slip happened without a length mismatch. The entry has an "Atomic model" revision but is still flagged.
No starting model stated in the text. Lambda CDR2 run 57-70 (+1) next to unbuilt residues; the first built residue is IMGT 3.

X-ray. The model was started from the STEC90-C11 Fab (7B3O) and "the sequence ... was slowly changed to that of P4A2". The template CDR-H2 is 7 residues, P4A2 has 8, and the run 62-82 is shifted +1, so the extra residue was absorbed by sliding FR3. This is a textbook template-threading error.

"Most of the Fab ... was built based on a preexisting model at high resolution (5UCB)". The Fab E6 FR3 is two residues shorter than 5UCB (ANARCI gaps 94-95; FR3 36 vs 38), and FR3 72-92 is shifted +1 (25th-percentile fit). The length mismatch is exactly at the slipped strand.

No starting model stated. The kappa FR3 FSGSGSGTDF slipped by -2 (76-93), exactly the period of the SG repeat. The same -2 kappa FR3 slip is in 7stf (Miller M.). The germline IGKV3-11 light chain had been solved at high resolution 14 times before.
Mouse IGHV5-15 (mouse IGHV5 is enriched in mode C; see ../deepdive). Six residues are unbuilt near the run (71-89, +1). No open-access text.

The yeast EMC was built de novo by hand, with landmark residues used to assign sequence. FR3 run 80-93 (-2) next to 9 unbuilt residues. The same germline V region had two earlier high-resolution structures, which were not used.
Mouse Fab, 4 unbuilt residues next to FR3 run 87-95 (-2). An "Atomic model" revision was later deposited, but the run is still present.

One-residue FR3 deletion (ANARCI gap at 85 instead of the usual 81). The 81-84 (+1) run lies between the two possible gap positions. Probably a gap-placement artifact (pattern seen in 2 chains, no high-resolution example).

Short FR2 run 44-47 (-1, QKPG) in an HCV E1E2-Fab map. No open-access text.

Starting models 5HDQ and 1NMC. The mouse 6D10 VH has an FR1 deletion (SCQA-FYTF; ANARCI gap at 26). SAbR shows the same 27-35 disagreement on the 2.49 A structure 5AAM, so this is a numbering artifact. A different lab's anti-echovirus-3 Fab 5G3 (7eaj/7eak) has the same rare FR1 deletion and the same artifact.

Rabbit Fab M8b-B8. The model was started by docking human Fab-RBD structures (7UZD, 7UZ4) into a locally refined map. The rabbit CDR-H1 (SSSYWICW, 9 residues, with an extra Cys) differs in length from the templates (8 or 10), and CDR1 is shifted +1 (31-41). The V-domain local resolution is 6.7 A against 3.4 A global. The same chain also has an FR3 run on an artifact-prone FR3 gap (84).

The recorded starting model 3U74 is uPAR alone, so there was no Fab template. The mouse IGKV1-117 light chain has an 11-residue CDR-L1, and the whole chain from CDR1 to the end is shifted +5 (31-127). The CDR-L1 insertion was absorbed downstream. 4.8 A map; ISOLDE was used.

X-ray molecular replacement with CB6 (7C01, whose kappa light chain has CDR-L1 of 6) for a lambda chain with CDR-L1 of 8. FR2-CDR2-FR3 is shifted +1 (45-80). The upstream length difference was absorbed downstream.
